places.name: San Antonio River
places.note: The jittery crew dreads moccasins, but Deets finds a shallow crossing a mile or two from camp and the herd, wagon and pigs cross without trouble.
places.location_hint: the next river north of the Nueces crossing on the drive

places.name: Cimarron River
places.note: The hands argue whether water moccasins live that far north.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Named in the crew's debate over how far north moccasins range.

places.note: Named in the crew's debate over how far north moccasins range.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Pea Eye's recurring dreams of a big Indian returned as soon as they left it.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus asks who will buy the cattle there; Call says the point is claiming land before settlers arrive.

groups.hint: just across the San Antonio River, about a week after the Nueces crossing
